summary: The implementation satisfies the saved P1 local packaging plan: awf service bootstrap orchestrates agent runtime image build, Postgres startup, forced migrate rerun, API/worker startup, and readiness polling; the CLI exposes the planned options with clean failure handling; README documents the repeatable bootstrap path and Compose fallback; focused service and CLI tests cover the planned behavior. Required validation passed: pytest tests/unit/cli tests/unit/service, ruff check src/awf tests scripts, and mypy src/awf.
